description.narrative: Global objective: Contribute to the accountability of states, individuals and companies for acts of grand corruption that have a negative impact on human rights Specific objective 1 : The capacity of local CSOs to address grand corruption that has a negative impact on human rights is strengthened Specific objective 2: Individuals, states and companies are held accountable for grand corruption This is a pilot consortium between FIDH, Transparency International and Transparency Internationale France aiming to strengthen the capacity of 23 FIDH and TI member organisations and partners in their actions to combat grand corruption that have a negative impact on human rights. The project aims to contribute to the accountability of States, individuals and companies for acts of grand corruption. The project responds first and foremost to the need to create a method of documenting grand corruption with an impact on human rights-the need to strengthen the capacities of human rights defenders and the fight against corruption-impunity for acts of grand corruption and the invisibility of victims of corruption; the need to strengthen the positions of global governance that is still too fragmented on these issues.Value of the contract is 525,985 Euros. This project is funded by Agence française de développement (AFD) via FiDH

recipient-country.narrative: This project is managed by TI-S which is headquartered in Germany. The countries involved are Colombia, Dominican Republic, Guatemala, Venezuala, Democratic Republic of Congo, Gabon, The Gambia, Kazakhstan, Pakistan, and Palestine
